comment: The parameter indices are not in panel order: index 0, 7 and 13 are the three attenuverters, sitting among the twelve note buttons, and 15 and 16 are transpose and nudge, in that order, while the panel prints Nudge to the left of Transpose. The manual (written for 2.4.0) says that with no notes selected every input is rounded to the nearest C; in this build the quantized value is only recomputed when at least one note is on (Quantify.cpp guards it with a test on the key mask), so the outputs hold whatever they last had. The note displays are fed from the pre-transpose value, which the manual also flags.
